title: Website in a garden
slide_intent: Give a digital service a tangible setting because an abstract tool can feel more approachable through familiar surroundings.
strategic_value: A yellow interface in a planted scene can extend Mailchimp’s combination of useful software and playful imagery.
demonstration: A monitor in grass beneath a toucan shows a yellow website; its right-side line illustration transforms while the headline and controls remain in place.
practical_value: Compare animated illustration with stable interface copy in one composition.

content_islands.name: Environment
content_islands.spec: Frame the monitor with tree, foliage, toucan and small plants.

content_islands.name: Interface
content_islands.spec: Keep headline and controls at left while the hand-drawn figure changes at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The film presents an animated illustration inside a website layout.
reference_purposes.Expression: A realistic planted setting contrasts with the yellow interface and transforming drawing.
